sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS REAL) / 12 AS monthly_avg_schools_opened
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda' AND s.DOC = 52 AND strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) = '1980'
